name: sentinelforge
description: Shows SentinelForge security findings on the lines they are on. Runs the scanner locally; nothing in the workspace is executed.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The scanner reads the workspace and executes nothing in it. The interpreter and the scanner's location come from user settings only and cannot be set by a workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The scanner reads files from disk.

sentinelforge.backendPath.markdownDescription: The full path of SentinelForge's `backend` folder, for example `C:\SentinelForge\backend`. **User setting only**: a workspace cannot set this, because it decides which code is run.

sentinelforge.pythonPath.markdownDescription: The Python interpreter that has the backend's requirements installed, for example `C:\SentinelForge\backend\venv\Scripts\python.exe`. **User setting only**: a workspace cannot set this.

sentinelforge.scanOnSave.description: Scan again whenever a file is saved.

sentinelforge.exclude.markdownDescription: Paths or globs whose findings are left out, for example `tests` or `*.min.js`. The number left out is shown in the status bar's tooltip.

sentinelforge.timeoutSeconds.description: Give up on a scan after this many seconds.
